name: logo
title: Logo ◈ Brand Marks
description: The fleet's brand-mark service. Every module's logo — a glyph, a hosted image, or an uploaded file — lives here instead of inside the module that shows it, and only that module's OWNER can change it. Writes are gated on a mod-protocol token whose signature must recover the target module's configured owner, so a console can display and offer to edit a mark without ever holding the power to change one.
frontend: app/server.py (stdlib — the console at /logo on :50761; proxies /logo/_api to the API)

authorization.read: public — a logo is what everyone sees; gating it on a session would only make the corner flicker
authorization.write: the TARGET module's owner. The caller sends a mod-protocol token (`m.mod('auth').token`); its signature must recover the address in that module's own config.json `owner` field, or an address in ~/.mod/{module}/owners.json
authorization.why: this module holds no credential standing in for anybody. A peer that proxies a save (see orbit/build) forwards the owner's signed token and cannot mint one, so proxying the UI never grants the power to change the mark

endpoints.GET /health: liveness + how many marks are set
endpoints.GET /status: auth mode, token max age, where state lives
endpoints.GET /whoami: the address behind a token, and which modules it may write
endpoints.GET /marks: every module that has a mark set
endpoints.GET /logo/{module}/image: public — the uploaded bytes, CSP-hardened, immutable per ?v=
endpoints.GET /logo/{module}/owner: who may write this module's mark, and where that came from
endpoints.DELETE /logo/{module}: owner-only — back to the protocol cube
